decisions.reason: As a newly launched upholstery fabric in a core textile category and highlighted on its own page, it is likely to stay in the range while the firm builds market acceptance.

This decorative bouclé-effect fabric looks more fashion-sensitive and was only mentioned rather than strongly featured, but after just one year a medium-sized textile firm would usually still give it more time.
Its flame-retardant specification and dedicated product page suggest a clear professional use case and stronger strategic value, making withdrawal unlikely in the near term.
A double-face wool-blend decoration fabric is relatively niche and cost-sensitive, so it carries some rationalisation risk, though it would normally remain listed beyond its first year.

This semi-transparent wool bouclé leno fabric appears to be a specialised decorative article with narrower demand and weaker website emphasis, but the firm would still likely keep it unless early sales disappointed clearly.
